pl-l4d48c1-d1e115.summary: Asks in what form Christ will judge.

pl-l4d48c1-d1e118.summary: Answers that he will judge in the form of a servant, which will appear to all at the judgment, so that the wicked see whom they pierced; they will not see his divinity, as Isaiah says, 'let the impious be taken away, lest he see the glory of God'; they will see his humanity to fear, not his divinity to rejoice, since divinity cannot be seen without joy.
claims: The wicked see Christ's humanity, not his divinity.

pl-l4d48c1.summary: Christ will judge in the form of a servant, which will appear to all, so that the wicked see him whom they pierced; they will not see his divinity, lest they rejoice, since the divinity cannot be seen without joy, but will see his humanity and fear.
claims: Christ will judge in human form, visible to all.
The wicked will not see his divinity, since it cannot be seen without joy.
